blockingLoop.evidence: Identical message twice: 'I can't diagnose that problem with your hob here yet, so I won't guess at a cause or a part.'

rationale: The assistant produced the same boilerplate refusal twice, asked no questions, and ignored the customer's direct safety worry ('should i be worried about it catching fire?') and the new details they volunteered (Neff induction, 6 months, no smell or codes). A normal post-use cooling fan is a very simple, common case that should have been reassured in one or two turns; instead the homeowner was pointed to an engineer for a non-fault. The generic stop-use advice is not wrong and nothing was invented or recommended, but the conversation was a complete loop with zero progress.
